_comment: Per research upgrade: which units list it, its icon (public/images/upgrades) and the English name and effect. Korean names, costs, research times and Korean effect text are read from the mod by extract-upgrades.js (the in-game text). English text keeps the numbers of the Korean tooltip. Entries with 'manual' are not BPM_ upgrades and carry their own Korean text.

en.name: Napalm Ammo
en.effect: Increases damage against Light by 5 and the Firebat's attack range by 2, and reduces the attack delay.

en.name: Infantry Heavy Armor
en.effect: Increases Firebat and Marauder health by 25 and changes them to Armored.

en.name: Shatter Shells
en.effect: Marauder Concussive Shells slow enemy units within 1.5 range. Requires Concussive Shells and Ghost Academy.

en.name: Charon Boosters
en.effect: Increases the Goliath's anti-air missile range by 3.

en.name: Haywire Missile
en.effect: Lets the WarHound use Haywire Missile, which deals extra damage to Armored units.

en.name: Crucio Suppressor
en.effect: In Sieged Mode, reduces direct and splash damage dealt to friendly units by 75%. Requires Armory.

en.name: Cloaking Field
en.effect: Lets the Wraith cloak.

en.name: Apollo Reactor
en.effect: Increases the Wraith's maximum energy by 50 and starting energy by 50.

en.name: Defensive Matrix
en.effect: Lets the Science Vessel use Defensive Matrix. Requires Fusion Core.

en.name: Lockdown Missile
en.effect: Lets the Science Vessel use Lockdown Missile. Requires Fusion Core.

en.name: Science Vessel Boost
en.effect: Lets the Science Vessel use Science Vessel Boost.

en.name: Integrated Fire Control Network
en.effect: Lets the Raven use Integrated Fire Control Network.

en.name: Singularity Charge
en.effect: Increases the Dragoon's range by 1.

en.name: Phasing Mode
en.effect: Lets the Energizer activate Phasing Mode.

en.name: Shield Overcharge
en.effect: Increases the Energizer's maximum shields by 40. (40 → 80)

en.name: Disruption Web
en.effect: Lets the Corsair cast Disruption Web. Enemy ground units and structures inside the web cannot attack.

en.name: Apial Sensors
en.effect: Increases the Scout's sight by 2.

en.name: Gravitic Thrusters
en.effect: Increases the Scout's movement speed by 33%.

en.name: Scarab Damage
en.effect: Increases Reaver Scarab damage by 25.

en.name: Scarab Capacity
en.effect: Increases the Reaver's maximum loaded Scarabs by 5.

en.name: Stasis Field
en.effect: Lets the Arbiter cast Stasis Field, freezing targets in place so they cannot act.

en.name: Recall
en.effect: Lets the Arbiter teleport friendly units at a chosen location to itself.

en.name: Leg Muscle Enhancement
en.effect: Increases the Aberration's movement speed. (3.5 → 4.13)

en.name: Volatile Spines
en.effect: Increases Volatile Spines' range by 1.

en.name: Plague
en.effect: Lets the Defiler cast Plague, dealing damage over time to enemy units and structures in the target area.

en.name: Consume
en.effect: Lets the Defiler absorb a friendly Zerg unit to restore 50 energy.

en.name: Metasynaptic Node
en.effect: Increases the Defiler's starting energy by 25 and maximum energy by 50.

en.name: Gamete Meiosis
en.effect: Increases the Classic Queen's maximum energy by 50 and starting energy by 50.

en.name: Primal Molt
en.effect: Increases the Tyrannozor's armor by 1. Requires Ultralisk Cavern.

ko.name: 전투 자극제
ko.effect: 체력을 소모해 잠시 이동 속도와 공격 속도를 높입니다.

en.name: Stimpack
en.effect: Spend health to briefly raise movement and attack speed.
